note: The enquiry form stage 09 places in a blueprint's form slot (fill \"site\"); every other form of the site (the resource request) posts the same way. Status \"not-connected\": laid out but disabled, no action. Status \"ready\" (the default; owner 2026-11-17: the forms go to the site's info@ mailbox): live in the page, it posts to the endpoint, the first-party API on the same origin (Nginx proxies /api/ and passes the recipient in the X-Lead-Recipient header), which forwards each enquiry to the recipient; stage 11 still holds the release until the status is \"connected\", set once a real POST has been tested on the server. The recipient is info@ the site's domain ({domain}: src/data/site-identity.json origin) and is never written into a page. Consent links to the privacy page; the honeypot field is hidden from people and left empty by them. Each field says what it is for beside it (Modern Web Guidance, privacy.md); requiredNote explains the asterisk; messages are announced in the form's live region. resourceRequest is the form a page offering guides, templates or downloads carries (owner 2026-11-17): the same endpoint and status, a hidden request_type field so the owner's mailbox tells requests from enquiries. A field's recorded is what the privacy page's table says it records when its label is no noun ("Anything else"; lib/data-practices.mjs, exported to config/site-collection.json).

askNote: ask: the fields a site's enquiry form asks before the message, by the site's kind (lib/lead-form.mjs enquiryKind: a site with product category pages, a maker's, asks product; any other, a service business's, asks service), so a buyer can say what, how many and by when without a second email (site13 claude-seo audit 2026-11-17, M-15: the quote page asked for a tech pack, size chart, quantity per colour and a target date the form had no field for). A choice field is a list of the site's own pages of those pageTypes (the plan's label) and other, or a text box on a site without such pages. No file upload: /api/leads takes form fields only; a tech pack is sent as a link. Every ask field is optional and records the same thing, so the privacy table's row is one for both kinds.
